name: Nitroglycerin (intravenous)
high_alert_note: Not confirmed as high-alert on a source read; the institution's list governs.
summary: Intravenous vasodilator for peri-operative hypertension, heart failure in acute myocardial infarction and angina and other labelled uses (the product read is nitroglycerin in dextrose). Nursing focus: vasodilator effects, headache and the effect of tubing material on delivery.
evidence_type_note: The evidence here is a regulator product label (prescribing information written for prescribers and pharmacists). It is not a bedside nursing practice guideline: the nursing actions are inferences from label warnings, marked partial, and the unit's protocol governs practice.
jurisdiction_note: US FDA label only. EMA, MHRA and SFDA labels were not read; indications, warnings and presentations differ by country and by manufacturer.

items.text: The label describes nitroglycerin in dextrose injection as indicated for peri-operative hypertension, for control of heart failure in the setting of acute myocardial infarction and for treatment of angina pectoris in other settings.
Use the infusion set and tubing the pharmacy and unit protocol specify, and report any doubt about the delivery equipment.
Monitoring frequency and alarm limits follow the unit's protocol for this medicine.
The label calls for monitoring of patients who may be volume depleted or already hypotensive.

Some plastic infusion tubing can adsorb nitroglycerin, so the amount delivered can differ from what was intended; the label states no simple correction can be applied, so the pharmacy's specified equipment matters.
Adverse reactions are generally dose-related and almost all result from vasodilator activity; headache, which may be severe, is the most commonly reported.
Escalate for severe headache, marked hypotension, dizziness or fainting, or chest pain.
Record the product and order checks, monitoring results, adverse events and escalation per unit standard.
Institution-specific preparation: follow your pharmacy's preparation standard and the product labelling. This library gives no preparation or concentration instructions.
Institution-specific dosing: follow the prescriber's order and your institution's approved protocol. This library gives no dosing instructions.

monitoring.text: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate at the unit's frequency.
Confirm the specified infusion set is in use.
Report hypotension, fainting or worsening chest pain.
